derivation: Original brief and tentative exact plan; no golden products, sources or method-conditioned answers.

six_axes.assessment: All original brief/plan material behavior and negative constraints addressed.
Consequential source facts grounded in governing primary context with subject/version/platform/conditions intact.
Useful unfamiliar mechanisms, viable alternatives and relevant history; missing material families recorded.
Valid supported corrections, criticism rejections and tentative-plan retain/change/reject decisions.
Supported draft/criticism meaning survives into the complete final, including conditions and alternatives.
Meaningful feasible validation; executed work distinguished from future proposals and unknown user data.

obligations.name: Request identity and fresh publication
obligations.assessment: Prevent obsolete output from becoming the current preview; explain request/document/cache validity and publication boundaries.

obligations.name: Priority and resource economy
obligations.assessment: Favor visible work while preventing starvation; identify practical worker/resource limits and alternatives.

obligations.name: Cancellation/shutdown semantics
obligations.assessment: Describe cooperative and child-process cancellation, lifecycle/cleanup and responsive shutdown without unsupported guarantees.

obligations.name: Failure and untrusted handlers
obligations.assessment: Handle crash, stall, retry and format-handler isolation/recovery with applicable platform conditions.

obligations.name: Persistence and progress
obligations.assessment: Cover restart-safe queue/result handling and truthful known/unknown progress.

obligations.name: Scope and constraints
obligations.assessment: Local, unprivileged, no GPU/upload requirement; no deployment/universal benchmark obligation, meaningful mechanism research still required.

validation_expectation: Propose checks for rapid switch/edit, stale completion after cancellation, background starvation, hung or crashing children, shutdown/restart at publication boundaries and unknown page counts. Any small executed witness must name its scope and oracle; future behavior stays proposed.
evaluation_rules: Use source-supported qualitative dispositions, not citation/answer-length counts.
Material unsupported claims, required omissions, false rejection or preservation loss preclude a full source pass.
A decisive stopped screen leaves every unassessed axis explicit.
Observed evaluator/candidate discovery union is finite, not universal external-world recall.
Unknown local user data may remain unknown; available mechanism research remains required.
